424: export const checkStreakThresholds = async ({
425: 	db,
426: 	seasonPlayerIds,
427: }: {
428: 	db: DrizzleDB;
429: 	seasonPlayerIds: string[];
430: }): Promise<
431: 	Array<{
432: 		seasonPlayerId: string;
433: 		playerId: string;
434: 		playerName: string;
435: 		playerImage: string | null;
436: 		streak: number;
437: 	}>
438: > => {
439: 	if (seasonPlayerIds.length === 0) return [];
440: 
441: 	const allMatches = await db.all<{
442: 		seasonPlayerId: string;
443: 		result: "W" | "L" | "D";
444: 		playerId: string;
445: 		playerName: string | null;
446: 		playerImage: string | null;
447: 	}>(sql`
448: 		SELECT
449: 			mp.season_player_id as seasonPlayerId,
450: 			mp.result,
451: 			p.id as playerId,
452: 			u.name as playerName,
453: 			u.image as playerImage
454: 		FROM (
455: 			SELECT
456: 				season_player_id,
457: 				result,
458: 				created_at,
459: 				ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_player_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) as rn
460: 			FROM match_player
461: 			WHERE season_player_id IN ${seasonPlayerIds}
462: 		) mp
463: 		INNER JOIN season_player sp ON mp.season_player_id = sp.id
464: 		INNER JOIN player p ON sp.player_id = p.id
465: 		INNER JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id
466: 		WHERE mp.rn <= 16
467: 		ORDER BY mp.season_player_id, mp.created_at DESC
468: 	`);
469: 
470: 	const matchesByPlayer = new Map<string, typeof allMatches>();
471: 	for (const match of allMatches) {
472: 		const existing = matchesByPlayer.get(match.seasonPlayerId) || [];
473: 		existing.push(match);
474: 		matchesByPlayer.set(match.seasonPlayerId, existing);
475: 	}
476: 
477: 	const results: Array<{
478: 		seasonPlayerId: string;
479: 		playerId: string;
480: 		playerName: string;
481: 		playerImage: string | null;
482: 		streak: number;
483: 	}> = [];
484: 
485: 	for (const [seasonPlayerId, recentMatches] of matchesByPlayer) {
486: 		const thresholdResult = checkThresholds(recentMatches);
487: 		if (thresholdResult) {
488: 			results.push({
489: 				seasonPlayerId,
490: 				playerId: thresholdResult.playerId,
491: 				playerName: thresholdResult.playerName,
492: 				playerImage: thresholdResult.playerImage,
493: 				streak: thresholdResult.streak,
494: 			});
495: 		}
496: 	}
497: 
498: 	return results;
499: };

501: function detectStreak(results: string[]): number {
502: 	for (const threshold of [15, 10, 5]) {
503: 		if (results.length < threshold) continue;
504: 
505: 		const firstN = results.slice(0, threshold);
506: 		const nextOne = results[threshold];
507: 
508: 		const allWins = firstN.every((r) => r === "W");
509: 		const allLosses = firstN.every((r) => r === "L");
510: 
511: 		if (allWins && (!nextOne || nextOne !== "W")) {
512: 			return threshold;
513: 		}
514: 		if (allLosses && (!nextOne || nextOne !== "L")) {
515: 			return -threshold;
516: 		}
517: 	}
518: 	return 0;
519: }

521: function checkThresholds(
522: 	recentMatches: Array<{
523: 		result: string;
524: 		playerId: string;
525: 		playerName: string | null;
526: 		playerImage: string | null;
527: 	}>
528: ): { playerId: string; playerName: string; playerImage: string | null; streak: number } | null {
529: 	const results = recentMatches.map((m) => m.result);
530: 	const streak = detectStreak(results);
531: 	if (streak === 0) return null;
532: 
533: 	const firstMatch = recentMatches[0];
534: 	return {
535: 		playerId: firstMatch.playerId,
536: 		playerName: firstMatch.playerName || "Unknown",
537: 		playerImage: firstMatch.playerImage,
538: 		streak,
539: 	};
540: }
